paper_title: Searching for Particle Dark Matter with eROSITA Early Data
notes: Paper searches for decaying DM X-ray lines with eROSITA eFEDS data. Main ALP result (Fig 7) constrains g_agamma in GeV^-1 over ma=2-18 keV. Data points are approximate readings from Fig 7 (no numerical table provided); axis range ~1e-19 to 1e-17 GeV^-1. Local DM density rho_sun=0.4 GeV/cm^3 with NFW profile. Paper also reports sterile neutrino mixing angle and model-independent decay rate limits. The eFEDS limit is the observed/measured limit; projections (MW center, all-sky) are separate. Mass converted from keV to eV.
